title: Greet World by name
size: small
domains: [app]

Change the greeting and add the required safety line.

## Acceptance
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains Hello, World!
- A2: lib/greet.txt contains SAFE

## Verify
- A1: test
- A2: test

## Request
Write Hello, World! and SAFE on separate lines.
intent.test_text:
t_A1() { grep -qx 'Hello, World!' lib/greet.txt; }
t_A2() { grep -qx 'SAFE' lib/greet.txt; }

## Technical approach
Change lib/greet.txt and verify both approved items.
